data.notes: Most Miami club calendars for May 2027 are not yet published; the confirmed picture is currently strongest in ticketed concerts, jazz, Latin pop and Memorial Day Caribbean programming.

events.title: Sizzle Miami 2027
events.summary: Long-running Black gay Memorial Day weekend party institution with pool parties, oceanfront day parties, yacht parties, and nightlife events; listed music focus includes Afrobeats, house, hip-hop, dancehall, and R&B.

events.title: Best of the Best Music Fest 2027
events.summary: CaribTix lists Best of the Best Music Fest 2027 in Miami for May 30, 2027. The long-running Memorial Day weekend event is Miami's signature Caribbean music festival, though the 2027 lineup is not yet posted on the ticket page.

events.title: SweetHeat Miami 2027
events.summary: Weeklong queer women-focused Miami destination party with DJ-driven nightlife, day parties, pool parties, yacht experiences, themed parties, R&B and throwback programming.

events.title: Memorial Weekend – Urban Beach Week
events.summary: Memorial Day weekend South Beach urban/hip-hop scene takeover listed with live performances, beach events, and shows throughout South Beach.

events.title: Christian McBride Big Band
events.venueName: Knight Concert Hall at Adrienne Arsht Center
events.summary: The Adrienne Arsht Center confirms Christian McBride Big Band for May 6, 2027 at 8:00 PM as part of its Jazz Roots series. The program features the 17-piece band performing music from McBride's big-band recordings.

events.title: Miami Takeover 2027 Experience Wknd
events.summary: Annual Haitian Flag Day weekend takeover billed as multiple themed events with dancing, partying, and culture-focused nightlife across the weekend.

events.title: Ha*Ash - No Me Hablen de Amor
events.venueName: The Fillmore Miami Beach at Jackie Gleason Theatre
events.summary: Live Nation confirms Ha*Ash's No Me Hablen de Amor show at The Fillmore Miami Beach on May 22, 2027 at 8:00 PM. The Mexican-American duo brings a major Latin pop concert to Miami Beach.

events.title: MIAMI NICE 2027 Memorial Day Weekend Annual All White Yacht Party
events.summary: Memorial Day weekend all-white yacht party from long-running promoter MIAMINICE, sailing from the South Beach Lady in Hollywood/North Beach area with a 21+ nighttime party format.

events.title: Paloma Morphy
events.summary: Shotgun lists Paloma Morphy at ZeyZey Miami on May 12, 2027, from 7:00 PM to 2:00 AM. The listing describes an 18+ Latin indie-pop concert with special guests to be announced.

events.title: Valery Meladze
events.summary: Live Nation lists Valery Meladze at James L Knight Center on May 1, 2027 at 8:00 PM. The show is a Russian-language pop concert in downtown Miami.

events.title: Sounds and Spirit of Haiti featuring Tradisyon Lakou Lakay
events.venueName: Knight Concert Hall at Adrienne Arsht Center
events.summary: The Arsht Center confirms Sounds and Spirit of Haiti on May 22, 2027 at 3:00 PM. The performance features Miami-based Tradisyon Lakou Lakay with live music, traditional rhythms, folkloric dance and Haitian storytelling.
